title: Usurper
summary: USURP'ER, noun One who seizes or occupies the property of another without right; as the usurper of a throne, of power, or of the rights of a patron.

inlines.v: USURP'ER, noun One who seizes or occupies the property of another without right; as the usurper of a throne, of power, or of the rights of a patron.
